description: Creates a new registration/visit record for an existing patient. A patient may have multiple registrations over time.

body.registrationType: string, optional - not a persisted column (see notes)
body.status: string(50), optional - persisted as registration_status, default REGISTERED

validation: patientId must reference an existing patient (patient_registrations.patient_id NOT NULL FK)
registrationNumber must not be null (NOT NULL)
registrationNumber must be unique within organization + branch (UNIQUE organization_id, branch_id, registration_number)

errors.condition: registrationNumber already exists within organization + branch

notes: docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx documents a 'registrationType' request field (e.g. WALK_IN), but patient_registrations has no registration_type column in any schema version through v25 - only registration_status exists. registrationType is listed here for completeness of the documented contract but is not currently persisted anywhere; it is either dead in the current schema or planned but not yet migrated. Also note: created_by is a required (NOT NULL) FK to users on this table - the creating user's ID must be resolved server-side (e.g. from the authenticated session), it is not a documented request field.
